package.name: fr3_gravity_ff_controller
package.description: Goal-execution-fragility oscillation fix: minimal ros2_control effort-interface controller adding gravity+Coriolis feedforward (via a small, self-contained KDL model -- deliberately not the shared fr3_dynamics package, whose moveit_core dependency made it unloadable by mujoco_ros2_control_node) on top of the same PD structure fr3_ros_controllers.yaml's stock joint_trajectory_controller already uses -- fr3_arm_controller's drop-in replacement.
